skill.summary: AI 视频生成技能，支持 Luma Dream Machine、Runway ML、Kling AI 等多个平台。文生视频、图生视频。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI 视频生成技能 (AI Video Generator):

- Supports Luma Dream Machine, Runway ML (Gen-2/3), and Kling AI platforms for video generation.
- Provides commands for text-to-video and image-to-video workflows.
- Flexible API key configuration via parameter or environment variables.
- Includes platform comparison table and guidance on file naming.
- Documents common errors and recommended usage workflow.
